newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BNDESPar to sell Eletrobras shrs today.
newsitem.headline: BNDESPar to sell Eletrobras shrs today.

text.p: Brazil's BNDES Participacoes, the investment wing of the National Development Bank (BNDES), said it would auction on Tuesday 124 million Eletrobras preferred shares combined with the same amount of put options.

Each share combined with the put option will be sold at a minimum price of 360 reais at an auction at 1315 local/1615 GMT on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange (BVRJ), said Sergio Weguellin, from BNDESPar.
Weguellin said buyers will be allowed to trade the shares and options separately after the auction.
He also said the sale will be coordinated by Indosuez, Merrill Lynch, City brokerage and Banco Omega.
With the auction, BNDESPar will be selling the last lot of Eletrobras preferred "B" shares in its portfolio, he added.
